_comment: THE SHARD LIST IS DATA, NOT YAML (F080.5). A new shard is added by editing this
file; .github/workflows/test.yml reads it and builds its matrix from it.
WHY AN EXPLICIT LIST AND NOT AN AUTOMATIC SPLIT: an explicit list is checkable.
A new package belonging to no shard is INVISIBLE to an automatic split and would
simply never run. Here it is caught — scripts/check-shard-coverage.mjs fails when
any package with a test script is missing from this file, and it runs inside
WHY THE NAMES ARE NEUTRAL: the grouping is by MEASURED cost, not by theme. A
thematic name ('core', 'media') would become a lie the first time a package moves
to another bin for balance, and nobody would notice.
weight_seconds is the measured build+test CPU time per bin (turbo run test
--force --summarize, 2026-09-21, local M1). It keeps the bins balanced and is
deliberately NOT asserted anywhere: a number that reddens the gate when a test
gets slower is a number somebody eventually deletes.
